text.content:
Standard. A market town proud of its festival.

Lantern Night: A costume parade through the square at midnight.

The shopping list (5 items):

  1. The wedding cake in the shop window (essential)
  2. A tea service (essential)
  3. A top hat
  4. A coil of rope
  5. Turnip seed for next year’s lanterns

The furniture: a gilt mirror (Bulky), at the ironmonger (4).

Villagers: the mayor, in his best costume (judging the costume contest); the vicar (carrying a lantern and a pitchfork “for the parade”).

Standard: Suspicion Limit 11 · the way out 8 · the lock-up 10 · the final flight: mob 11, escape at Lead 5.

In Foundry

On the Raid HUD, New raid → Standard sets these numbers. To put this town’s list on the HUD (so its items show there and the end of the raid starts from them), run this as a script macro:

// Thistlewick: put this shopping list on the Raid HUD (run as the Storyteller, after New raid → Standard).
game.dontGetForked.runOp("raid.list", { action: "set", list: [
  { name: "the wedding cake in the shop window", duty: "cook", essential: true },
  { name: "a tea service", duty: "butler", essential: true },
  { name: "a top hat", duty: "tailor", essential: false },
  { name: "a coil of rope", duty: "handyman", essential: false },
  { name: "turnip seed for next year’s lanterns", duty: "gardener", essential: false }
] });

A location’s first two rows are its two ways in: the party picks one and keeps to it. The furniture’s obstacle is already 2 harder. Any move takes one Turn.
